title: Accounts
heading: Manage accounts
lead: New accounts come from a link you create here and pass on. Nobody else can sign up.

create.heading: Create an account
create.description: The link is valid for 7 days and works once.
create.name: Name
create.nameDescription: It is filled in already, the person can change it.
create.nameBlank: The name must not consist of spaces only.
create.nameTooLong: The name can have at most {{ max }} characters.
create.failed: The link could not be created

invites.heading: Open links
invites.loadFailed: The links could not be loaded
invites.copyFailed: The link could not be copied
invites.revokeDescription: The link stops working. You can create a new one at any time.
invites.revokeFailed: The link could not be revoked

users.heading: All accounts
users.loadFailed: The accounts could not be loaded
users.conflict: Your own account cannot be changed or deleted here.
users.madeAdmin: {{ name }} has admin rights now. This applies from the next request.
users.removedAdmin: {{ name }} has no admin rights any more. This applies from the next request.
users.revokeDescription: The account is signed out on every device and can sign in again afterwards.
users.deleteDescription: The account is deleted for good, with every event it owns, their guests and photos. Events where it is only an editor stay. This cannot be undone.
